# apploading.co

> Software built and run in production by one Cape Town-based engineer. Two productized platforms, plus a track record of custom builds for data, operations and consumer products. Solo builder: no agency, no account managers.

## Products

- **BuildTrack**: customer-facing order tracking and production-management platform for make-to-order businesses (furniture, kitchens, pools, bespoke manufacturing). Magic-link customer portal, nine-stage build timeline, photo approval workflow, real-time financials, QR-code field uploads. Live in 4-6 weeks. Setup R80,000-R120,000, retainer R6,000-R10,000 per month.
- **LoadKit**: white-label community and activity-logging platform for clubs and associations (running, cycling, surf, dive, open-water swimming). Location-based logging, group events with safety gates, challenges and leaderboards, push notifications, sponsor placements. Live in two weeks. Setup R25,000-R60,000, retainer R3,000-R8,000 per month.

Prices are quoted in South African Rand (ZAR). Invoicing in USD/EUR is available for international clients.

## How I work: forward deployed engineering

Dave Welensky works as a forward deployed engineer: embedded with the client rather than at a distance. That means scoping the real problem with the people doing the work, building production code inside the client's own systems and data, hardening it for daily use (access control, audit logs, alerts), and staying on after go-live. Improvements made for one BuildTrack or LoadKit client ship to every client on the platform.

## Proof of work (anonymized case studies, client names withheld)

- Data quality engine: 55 rules run daily against live SAP master data for an enterprise S/4HANA migration. 171,000 issues caught before go-live, with GPT-powered root-cause reporting.
- BuildTrack reference deployment: running for a Cape Town wellness-equipment manufacturer. R50,000-R250,000+ custom orders; support calls during the build phase dropped to zero.
- LoadKit reference deployment (SwimLoading, swimloading.com): an open-water swimming community platform with 675 swimmers across 15 countries and 3 clubs on one codebase.
- Ocean-swim operations platform: real-time boat, crew and mission coordination with safety-critical incident tracking, plus live family tracking for long-distance swims (position against planned route, pace, stroke rate, water temperature). Live since July 2026.
- Consulting operations platform: a 14-module internal operations system (timesheets, projects, leave, expenses, skills, staffing) for a consulting firm. 53 page routes, 44 API endpoints, 51 database tables.
- Website rebuild: migrated a professional-services firm's public site from WordPress to Next.js with schema.org markup and an llms.txt file, the same approach used on this site.
- Investment intelligence platform (private beta): an equity-market valuation system combining market data, historical PE ranges back to 1960, forward earnings expectations and analyst consensus. 3,200 PE observations across 4 indices.
